root_causes.description: product-catalog, a leaf service with no downstream dependencies, exhibits a severe p99 latency spike (~9.6s, max 10s) while CPU (0.011 cores), memory (~23.7MB), pod restarts (0), and error rate (0) all remain at baseline. Traces show slow-but-successful requests (5-16s) with zero errors, confirming a pure latency fault (likely injected delay) rather than resource saturation, crash, or abort. This latency propagates upstream to recommendation (p99 ~4.6s), checkout (p99 ~9.4s), and frontend (p99 ~9.6s).

evidence.expected_baseline: p99_latency_ms < 20 (p50 is 9.513ms; sibling leaf services payment/currency/shipping at ~1.98ms)

evidence.observed_value: cpu_usage mean=0.011, max=0.012 cores, no anomaly detected
evidence.expected_baseline: no CPU spike — rules out cpu_stress

evidence.observed_value: memory mean=23760896 bytes (~23.7MB), max=23904256, no anomaly detected
evidence.expected_baseline: no memory growth — rules out memory_stress

evidence.observed_value: pod_restarts=0.000 across window, no anomaly detected

20 traces, 0 with errors, p95_duration=600002ms; e.g. 2b40c40b443d1ce0 user_checkout_single 16246ms ok, e5a6d0ab1f739b20 user_browse_product 5403ms ok, 316c20fabcc43e85 user_get_recommendations 16133ms ok
[no logs found] — zero error logs in window
evidence.expected_baseline: no error logs, consistent with latency-only fault

root_causes.description: checkout shows p99 latency of ~9.4s, but this is propagation from its product-catalog dependency (checkout → product-catalog per topology), not a fault in checkout itself. Its other dependencies (cart, payment, shipping, currency) are all healthy at ~2-4ms p99.

evidence.observed_value: cart p99_latency_ms=3.880, no anomaly detected — checkout's other dependencies healthy

root_causes.description: frontend shows the highest observed p99 (~9.6s) as the user-facing entry point, but this is fully explained by its direct dependency on product-catalog (frontend → product-catalog per topology) plus the checkout and recommendation paths. No independent fault indicators at frontend.

evidence.observed_value: recommendation p99_latency_ms=4627.399, max=4820.000, anomaly detected — consistent with product-catalog propagation

remediation_steps: Inspect product-catalog for injected artificial latency: check flagd feature flags (e.g., latency-injection flags), recent deployments/config changes, and any sleep/delay code paths in the GetProduct/ListProducts handlers.
Roll back or disable the latency-inducing change on product-catalog (feature flag toggle via flagd or redeploy previous version) to restore sub-20ms p99.
Add strict client-side timeouts (e.g., 1-2s) with bounded retries in checkout, frontend, and recommendation calls to product-catalog so a single slow dependency cannot inflate end-user p99 to ~10s.
Add latency SLO alerts on product-catalog p99 (threshold ~100ms) to catch leaf-service latency faults before they propagate to the entire request path.
Verify recovery post-fix by re-querying p99 latency for product-catalog, checkout, and frontend to confirm return to baseline.
